title: Travel
description: A travel as the scale position law reads it (docs/scale-position.md): a scale word with its ends and, for a stepped one, its step; or the override module's map, linear between its points. The document @openmixer/omx-contract/scale and omx_contract.scale take; the shape every surface that nudges or draws a control reads.

ScaleTravel.title: ScaleTravel
ScaleTravel.description: A travel as a descriptor states it: a scale word of PARAM_SCALES with its ends; `unknown` is served linear; a log word over a floor that is not positive is served linear.

scale.description: The scale word: a law of PARAM_SCALES, or `unknown` when the descriptor states none (served linear).

min.description: The value at position 0, in the control's own unit.

max.description: The value at position 1, in the control's own unit.

step.description: The step of a stepped travel, in the control's own unit; absent for the other words.

ScaleMap.title: ScaleMap
ScaleMap.description: The override module's map: [plain value, quantity] points, ascending in the plain value, the position linear between them.

scale.description: The word `map`: not a word of PARAM_SCALES, the override module's table.

points.description: The points, at least two, each [plain value, quantity], ascending in the plain value.

items.description: One point: the plain value, then the quantity it maps to.
